summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a US$50 million private investment in public equity (PIPE). The PIPE involves convertible preference shares convertible into Class A Ordinary Shares at US$7.50 per share, with a 6% annual PIK coupon and warrants exercisable at a premium to market. Blue Sky Capital led the investment, Arctic Securities acted as sole placement agent, and entities associated with Executive Chairman Kevin Chin participated on the same terms. Proceeds will fund VivoPower's Mo i Rana AI data center operational conversion in Norway and corporate debt reduction. The securities are offered as restricted securities under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special-situations event.
